subject.title: lossless-claw bootstraps into quarantine after every Gateway restart due to new sessionId generating fresh JSONL file

question: Should OpenClaw add the default-off `session.restartContinuation` config contract for aborted main sessions, or require a different restart-recovery design before resolving this issue?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but accepting the proposed fix means adding new session configuration and changing compatibility-sensitive session reuse semantics.

options.title: Sponsor The Opt-In Contract
options.body: Accept the default-off `session.restartContinuation` behavior and review the linked PR for upgrade and session-state safety.

options.title: Reject The Config Surface
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a config-free recovery design or fold the work into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57425.

options.title: Wait For Live LCM Proof
options.body: Defer the product call until a real Gateway plus lossless-claw restart reproduction confirms the end-to-end quarantine path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor The Opt-In Contract
recommendation.body: Accept the default-off `session.restartContinuation` behavior and review the linked PR for upgrade and session-state safety.

likelyOwner.reason: They own adjacent Gateway restart recovery history and the broader graceful-restart discussion, while the session-code owners can review the exact implementation once the product boundary is chosen.
